page.notes: The left edge of the column is cut off, so the entries begin mid-word, for example "no" and "nes ueterum". The right edge of the page is also cut. The printed word "causfam" is copied as printed. "tedant" for tendant is copied as printed, and "aliu" is uncertain. The entry "Heracliti error de motu cō" stops at the cut. The running head "I N D" is cut off at the right edge, so its final letter is not visible. Uncertain readings: "138.148" in the first line (the digits are faint and the scan is cut at the top edge); the printed hyphens at the line ends of "ignem esse centrum, qui sta" and "proba-" are not clear, so these words are written as printed without a hyphen where none is visible. The large initial I of "IAm" is joined to the word as the rules require. The running head "E X." is read from the top line and may be a section letter rather than a title.
